cases.title: Erasing a pit keeps its pipe, says the pipe now has a free end, and one U restores the pit
cases.plan_item: UX-EDIT-01 / D14 singular-message branch only; whole-card several-pipe route is R19b
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with daily card D14 (DAILY_TOOLS_TEST_CASES_2026-10-23.md), done on the new pit P8 with one pipe instead of the old pit P3 counted through the Pit Schedule (unreadable on 3.0.72).
cases.expected: Select the new pit P8 and type ERASE: the pit goes (the object count falls), the pipe that started at it is still there (it can still be read), the command line says '1 pipe now has an end that is Not connected yet', and one U (echo word ERASE) brings the pit back and the object count returns to its value before the erase.
cases.why_not_unit: The message comes from CE watching a real native ERASE and its links in the drawing.
not_automated: The full card sentence is asserted for the ONE-pipe branch only (run B5, cx_cr05: PLAN_ITEM narrowed, exactly one pipe asserted).

The plural-pipe route and the schedule-derived pipe count belong to R19b. Run B5: the pipe read (ent-read) shows only handle, object and layer, so it cannot show the pit link; the link is read instead through the CDCHECK Problems totals before the erase and after U, whose totals line must read the same (218 objects, 189 connections, 184 Connected, 0 Not Connected): twin R19_NOU_BROKEN skips the U and reads 217 and 183. The totals count the whole drawing, not only pit P8.
